# Equiv
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.equiv
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for( k in 1 : P ) {
        for( i in 1 : N ) {
            Y[i , k] ~ dnorm(m[i , k], tau1)
            m[i , k] <- mu + sign[T[i , k]] * phi / 2 + sign[k] * pi / 2 + delta[i]
            T[i , k] <- group[i] * (k - 1.5) + 1.5
        }
    }
    for( i in 1 : N ) {
        delta[i] ~ dnorm(0.0, tau2)
    }
    tau1 ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001) 
    sigma1 <- 1 / sqrt(tau1)
    tau2 ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001) 
    sigma2 <- 1 / sqrt(tau2)
    mu ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    phi ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    pi ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    theta <- exp(phi)
    equiv <- step(theta - 0.8) - step(theta - 1.2)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
